title: Coloring a Tree
statementMd:
You are given a rooted tree with $*n*$ vertices. The vertices are numbered from $1$ to $*n*$, the root is the vertex number $1$.

Each vertex has a color, let's denote the color of vertex $*v*$ by $*c*_{*v*}$. Initially $*c*_{*v*} = 0$.

You have to color the tree into the given colors using the smallest possible number of steps. On each step you can choose a vertex $*v*$ and a color $*x*$, and then color all vectices in the subtree of $*v*$ (including $*v*$ itself) in color $*x*$. In other words, for every vertex $*u*$, such that the path from root to $*u*$ passes through $*v*$, set $*c*_{*u*} = *x*$.

It is guaranteed that you have to color each vertex in a color different from $0$.

You can learn what a rooted tree is using the link: [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tree_(graph_theory)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tree_(graph_theory)).

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $*n*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{4}$) — the number of vertices in the tree.

The second line contains $*n* - 1$ integers $*p*_{2}, *p*_{3}, ..., *p*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} < *i*$), where $*p*_{*i*}$ means that there is an edge between vertices $*i*$ and $*p*_{*i*}$.

The third line contains $*n*$ integers $*c*_{1}, *c*_{2}, ..., *c*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$), where $*c*_{*i*}$ is the color you should color the $*i*$-th vertex into.

It is guaranteed that the given graph is a tree.

## Output

Print a single integer — the minimum number of steps you have to perform to color the tree into given colors.

On third step we color all vertices in the subtree of vertex $2$ into color $1$:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6fa977fcdebdde94c47695151e0427b33d0102c5.png)

The tree from the second sample is shown on the picture (numbers are vetices' indices):

statementZhMd:
<statement>
给定一棵有 $*n*$ 个顶点的有根树。顶点编号从 $1$ 到 $*n*$，根节点编号为 $1$。

每个顶点都有一种颜色，顶点 $*v*$ 的颜色记为 $*c*_{*v*}$。初始时 $*c*_{*v*} = 0$。

你需要使用尽可能少的步骤，将这棵树染成给定的颜色。每一步中，你可以选择一个顶点 $*v*$ 和一种颜色 $*x*$，然后将 $*v*$ 的子树中的所有顶点（包括 $*v*$ 本身）染成颜色 $*x*$。换句话说，对于满足从根到 $*u*$ 的路径经过 $*v*$ 的每个顶点 $*u*$，设置 $*c*_{*u*} = *x*$。

保证你需要将每个顶点染成非 $0$ 的颜色。

你可以通过以下链接了解什么是有根树：[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tree_(graph_theory)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tree_(graph_theory))。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{4}$）——树中顶点的数量。

第二行包含 $*n*$ - 1 个整数 $*p*_{2}, *p*_{3}, ..., *p*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} < *i*$），其中 $*p*_{*i*}$ 表示顶点 $*i*$ 与顶点 $*p*_{*i*}$ 之间存在一条边。

第三行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*c*_{1}, *c*_{2}, ..., *c*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$），其中 $*c*_{*i*}$ 是你应当为第 $*i*$ 个顶点染成的颜色。

保证给出的图是一棵树。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——将这棵树染成给定颜色所需执行的最少步骤数。
